sentences.en: All the fire extinguishers worked, so there were no casualties.
sentences.zh: 所有的灭火器都起作用了，所以没有人员伤亡。

sentences.en: The first casualty of every war is the truth.
sentences.zh: 每一场战争的第一个受害者就是真相。

sentences.en: The number of civilian casualties in Gaza has shocked the world.
sentences.zh: 加沙地带平民的伤亡数字震惊了全世界。

senses.zh: 伤亡人员；受害者，毁坏物；急诊室，急救室；事故，灾难（主要用于保险中）
